Science and Technology Corporation (STC) is hiring a Software Engineer for its EOSDIS Evolution and Development (EED) program, supporting NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System. The role develops cloud-native web application features and data-access capabilities, using AWS services and collaborating with Agile teams.
Information Technology
Diversity & Inclusion
No H1B
U.S. Citizen Only
Responsibilities
Develop and maintain web application features using modern languages and frameworks (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java)
Build and consume RESTful APIs for earth science data access and integration with platform services
Leverage AWS cloud services (Lambda, S3, API Gateway) to deliver cloud-native solutions
Write and maintain automated unit and integration tests in support of CI/CD pipelines
Contribute to code reviews, bug fixes, and sprint deliverables in a collaborative Agile team environment
Work closely with Senior and Principal engineers to develop solutions aligned with program architecture and standards
Participate in Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) planning events, Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, and technical reviews
Collaborate with cross-functional teams within a large, multi-team Agile environment to deliver cloud-native earth science data capabilities on schedule
Contribute to CI/CD pipeline automation, code review, testing, and documentation in accordance with program standards
